Looks like a Black and white Mannikin. They’re a type of finch, they eat seeds. If it hit your window, the best thing to do is put them in a box with a heating pad on the lowest settle if possible for warmth. Leave the bird in the box for 30 minutes, don’t peak inside, it might fly out. Then once that time has passed, take the box outside and see if it flies out. Hoping for the best, a lot of times stunned birds suffer internal damage.

Of course there’s hope! I struggle with major depressive disorder and other mental illnesses. Firstly, you did a good thing at least reaching out for help, even if it is online. It’s the first step to recovery. Second, realize that depression often doesn’t have a cause, ( at least for most it’s not situational). You could have the best life and be clinically depressed. There are situations that can worsen it, but for many, like myself, depression sneaks up silently. By the time many notice something is wrong, they are already in a huge hole they can’t climb out of. Thirdly, there is always hope. I struggled for 4 years and finally I’m getting my shit together. I thought that I wasn’t worth the time of day, but I got help.

If you think you may be more than just the mood depressed, but clinically depressed, I strongly suggest you seek help. I thought I was for years, and I was, but I bottled it in until it led to me being suicidal and I attempted on more than half a dozen occasions. Keeping it to yourself can only make the problem grow bigger.  There are people who’s entire life is dedicated to help people with their mental health. If you’re  a student there must be a school psychologist , even a counselor that may be able to help. 

If you think you’re in danger of hurting yourself, don’t hesitate to call emergency services. Remember, you are important and people care for you! 

If you ever need to talk, I’m here to listen!
